name: Bilt Card

apr.notes: APR not displayed on product page.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not mentioned on product page.

credit_required.notes: Bilt does not publish minimum score requirements.

rewards.redemption_notes: Bilt Points transfer at 1:1 ratio to 28 airline and hotel transfer partners. Other redemptions: Bilt Travel Portal, future rent/mortgage payments, Lyft rides, fitness classes, statement credits, student loan payments, home down payment. The Points Guy values Bilt Points at 2.2 cents each.

benefits.title: No Transaction Fee on Rent, Mortgage and HOA
benefits.description: All Bilt Cards have no transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA. Pay via ACH, Venmo, PayPal, or check with no transaction fee and no payment portal convenience fee.

benefits.title: Bilt Neighborhood Dining
benefits.description: 20,000+ participating dining locations. Earn bonus Bilt Points per dollar on top of card's standard earn rate. No activation required.

benefits.title: Bilt Travel Portal Bonuses
benefits.description: Booking hotels through Bilt Travel earns +2X and flights +1X bonus Bilt Points on top of card's base rate.

benefits.title: 28 Airline and Hotel Transfer Partners
benefits.description: Points transfer at 1:1 ratio to 28 airline and hotel transfer partners including major domestic and international airline programs and leading hotel loyalty programs.

benefits.title: No Transaction Minimum
benefits.description: No 5-transaction monthly minimum to earn on housing. With Bilt Card 2.0, there is no transaction minimum to earn on housing.

notes: Bilt Card 2.0 now has three tiers: Bilt Blue (no annual fee), Bilt Obsidian ($95/year), Bilt Palladium ($495/year). This entry corresponds to the Bilt Blue Card (no annual fee).
